messages:
carmen: heads-up — moresby13b (int4) canary started throwing OOMs when we hit a few long-conversation traces. rolling back the canary for now.
drew: ugh, any log snippets?
carmen: paste:
```
2026-05-05T14:03:12Z WARN  kv_cache: slots_delta=+11 total_slots=578
2026-05-05T14:03:12Z ERROR oom: alloc failed attention_kv shm=1245600000
2026-05-05T14:03:12Z INFO  serving: req=tx-91 gen_tokens=1600 route=moresby13b-int4
```
oliver: 1600 tokens + prefetch_window=2 + default batch=4 — that's a lot of pre-allocated slots. int4 reduces bytes per tensor but the slot count still kills us.
maya: quick mitigation: lower route defaults and enable soft eviction + compactor cadence. propose defaults: max_new_tokens: 384, batch_size: 2, prefetch_window: 1, compactor_interval_s: 300, soft_evict: true.
zed: +1. also set a temporary per-pod kv_slot_cap=640 for the canary pool so we don't let slots grow unbounded while tuning.
drew: can we add a mem-probe harness to repro quickly? i can run a synthetic that replays long-conv traces but caps token generation to reproduce fragmentation pattern.
carmen: yes please — add `--mem-probe --deterministic` flags so it's reproducible. also capture `--nvml-snap` and `--jemalloc-arenas` during the run.
oliver: long-term, we should consider microbatching rule: if requested_gen_tokens >= 512 then limit batch_size<=2 for that request. avoids packing many long gens into one batch.
maya: also routing fallback: if requested_gen_tokens >= 1024 route to moresby13b-int8. safe short-term kill-switch.
build-bot: deploybot: canary patch queued by maya  job #5120 scheduled. will run smoke harness and upload artifacts. :hourglass: 
drew: diagnostics to collect during smoke: nvml snapshots every 30s, jemalloc arena stats, slot-usage histogram every 15s, and GPU page faults. add `--nvml-snap --jemalloc-arenas --slot-hist --gpu-pf` to the runner.
zed: smoke gating: run 60m with 200 randomized long-gen replays + 150 mixed conversations. gates: 1) 0 OOMs, 2) p95 <= 1.5x fp16 baseline, 3) embedding-sim drop <0.005 on our long-ctx eval. rollback if breaches.
carmen: small quality note — saw a tiny token alignment drift in nested code-block prompts; include 30 of those in the eval set and fail if any >1.5% token-mismatch.
oliver: if smoke still OOMs, fallback plan B: 1) serve int8 for requests >= 700 tokens, 2) temporarily lower compactor_interval_s to 120s, 3) enable aggressive soft_kv_evict on allocation failure.
maya: PR incoming with route defaults + slot cap + microbatch rule + runner flags. i'll link dashboards and expected baselines.
drew: one more diag: capture slot growth rate metric and expose on perf dashboard to watch slot churn during ramp. open a quick dashboard panel for the pool.
zed: after smoke passes, ramp plan: 5% traffic for 2h with slowstart (0.5x every 20m) and nvml snapshots at each step. collect artifacts and post here.
carmen: thanks all — i'll hold rollback until job #5120 finishes. auto-rollback if >2 OOMs in 30m or quality gate fails. tagging @eng-ml for follow-up. :thumbsup:
